derivation.behavior: Backend selection is deterministic and explainable.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Go selects among compatible healthy backends using user preference and operation requirements; switching after start requires migration.

invariants: Selection considers only backends whose exact compatibility contract accepts the operation.
Identical selection inputs produce identical selected backend, reason, rejection ordering, and explanation.
User preference is honored only when compatible and available; fallback follows the request fallback policy.
Runtime availability, backend health, operation shape, and migration cost are explicit selection inputs.
The selected reason and ranked candidate evidence are persisted as an attempt-scoped safe diagnostic before execution starts.
A started attempt remains bound to its existing backend; changing backend requires the explicit migration contract.
